title: Credit Limits, Review Times and Open-Order Multiples for Catering Clients
content:
The credit desk works a Corporate Catering Service Agreement to three figures printed against its service level.

**Credit limit.** The open-order and unsettled exposure the service level allows before ordering stops, in USD.

**Credit review time.** The working days a credit review takes before ordering opens.

**Open-order multiple.** The multiple of the credit limit at which open orders alone trigger a hold, to one decimal place.

| Service level | Credit limit | Credit review time | Open-order multiple |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Drop-Off Catering Account | 2500.00 USD | 2 working days | 1.0 |
| Delivered Buffet Account | 7500.00 USD | 3 working days | 1.2 |
| Attended Buffet Account | 18000.00 USD | 5 working days | 1.5 |
| Staffed Full-Service Catering Account | 45000.00 USD | 7 working days | 1.5 |
| Executive Hospitality Catering Account | 65000.00 USD | 7 working days | 2.0 |
| Campus Catering Master Account | 120000.00 USD | 10 working days | 2.0 |

By way of illustration, a hypothetical Attended Buffet Account carries a credit limit of 18000.00 USD and an open-order multiple of 1.5, so the open-order figure that corresponds to that multiple is 27000.00 USD; on a hypothetical Drop-Off Catering Account, whose multiple is 1.0, the corresponding figure is the credit limit itself, 2500.00 USD.
